milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The white terracotta structure is at spawn-relative (3-5, 0-2, 3-4), centered at (4, 1, 4). Player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate visual identification. Max distance 16 with 60° facing tolerance models 'player can see the target block'.

Uses inventory_has because mining clay blocks drops clay_ball items into the player's inventory (4 clay_balls per clay block mined). The player starts with no clay_balls, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. Clay blocks are placed at spawn-relative (3-5, 0, 5-6) behind the white terracotta structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The quartz bricks U-shaped enclosure is at spawn-relative (8-10, 0-2, 3-6), centered at (9, 1, 5). Player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate visual identification. Max distance 16 with 60° facing tolerance.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because pink stained glass drops nothing without Silk Touch (and even with Silk Touch, verifying block removal is more robust). Originally 4 pink_stained_glass blocks are placed at spawn-relative (9, 0-1, 4-5). Checking at most 3 remain in a generous box (6-12, -1 to 4, 1-8) confirms at least one was mined/destroyed.
